summary: This clinical trial is testing a study drug called ALN-4324 to see how it affects how the body handles insulin in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus, a condition where the body does not use insulin properly. The study compares the study drug against a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the real treatment. Alnylam Pharmaceuticals is sponsoring this Phase 2 trial, which has a status of Active, not recruiting and includes 24 participants.
